items.summary: CTO disposition: reject all new implementation admissions this cycle. Delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots, with active measurement, overlap, failed-request repair, and incomplete operations/security evidence. Preserve the canonical saveusfarms.com repair-or-close case as the capacity unblocker. After one slot is released and site overlap clears, admit only the existing allthingsmasonic.com affiliate CTA request; do not create duplicates. Keep scaffold work preview/readiness-only and preserve all legal, security, attribution, measurement, and rollback gates.

The proposed finance boundary reconciliation is technically feasible as report-only work outside implementation capacity, but it must use existing telemetry plus owner-provided dated billing exports only. It may report attribution coverage, AI cost, and cost-per-call, while leaving infrastructure cost, contribution margin, ROI, payback, and cost-to-learn unknown where identifiers or periods do not reconcile. No banking, billing, spending, duplicate telemetry, or forecasts are authorized.

Retain the reviewed disposable-workspace document prototype as capacity-gated research only. Isolation must remain local and read-only with owner-approved inputs, no dependency installation, no production access, no external publishing, and a provenance/error report plus human review before any adoption decision.
